name: com.adivery.sdk.core.UninstallReceiver
description: Adivery SDK receiver runs after Android reports that an app store package has been fully removed. It clears Adivery’s saved installation cache when the removed package matches a supported store and the removal is not an app replacement.
disableEffect: Adivery will no longer clear its installation cache when a supported store is removed; normal app features continue to work.
